title: Validity of the walk instruction checks
statement: Let $y$ be a valid plain encoding and let $a$ be any configuration with four registers and labels from the walk’s label set. The instruction selected by the walk at the state of $a$ satisfies the precondition checks for input $y$: any register comparison uses distinct registers, any comparison with the input word has a valid plain input, any call has distinct argument registers, and all other instructions satisfy their checks automatically.
hypotheses_covered: $a$ is a configuration with four registers and walk labels
the walk parameter $lm$ is a Boolean
